title: Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China
adopting_body: Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress
promulgation_text: The "Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China" was adopted by the 30th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China on August 20, 2021, is hereby promulgated, and shall come into force as of November 1, 2021.
